# Browser MCP

> > Browser MCP enables AI-powered browser automation through the Model Context Protocol, integrating with Claude, Cursor, VS Code, and Windsurf.

Browser MCP provides an MCP server (@browsermcp/mcp) and Chrome extension that allows AI assistants to control and automate browser interactions. Built by Road to Ramen LLC, it leverages the Model Context Protocol to connect AI coding assistants with web automation capabilities.

## Key Topics

- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- Browser automation
- Claude Desktop integration
- Cursor and VS Code support
- Chrome extension
- @browsermcp/mcp server
- Node.js runtime
- AI-assisted workflows
- Web automation testing
- MCP server configuration
- npx installation
- Windsurf integration
- AI coding assistants
